shell_commands: npm run prettier -- --write src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/index.ts src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -20
cd src/transport/ws && git diff messageHandler.ts | head -80

git add .lore/dod.md src/index.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts && git status

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(transport): add list_sessions validation and handler

Add WebSocket protocol support for listing user sessions:
- Validate list_sessions frames with limit and before cursor
- Handle list_sessions by calling store.listFor with authenticated userId
- Convert Date fields to ISO strings in session_list responses
- Return empty list when store lacks listFor; SERVER_ERROR on failure

Implements validation, message types, handler, and wiring.
Documentation and compliance flagging remain.
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -3

git commit --amend -m "$(cat <<'EOF'

Implements validation, message types, handler, and wiring.
Documentation and compliance flagging remain.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git log -1 --format=%B
git fetch origin main && git status
git push origin HEAD && git status
